item.text:
<linkedin_post>DoorDash’s experience offers an early measure of how often customers are using third-party AI agents to order food: several hundred orders in total, according to CEO Tony Xu.

The company reported an average of 3 million deliveries per day in 2025. The figures cover different periods, but they put the early agent activity alongside the scale of DoorDash’s existing business. Xu said customers still predominantly order through the app.

DoorDash is building its own AI ordering tools and looking to work with outside agent makers. Its approach leaves room to learn how customers use agents without assuming that ordering habits have already shifted.</linkedin_post>
